text:
Highly recommended dentist practice. The staff are courteous and professional.
The dentist is extremely proficient at offering and delivering various solutions to dental issues. The added bonus is that English is spoken.

I have heard some people berate dental services in Thailand, however at this small practice you will be treated with care and the cost of the services is not prohibitive.

I was so impressed! 🥹🙏 Dr. Waleeporn is amazing. I'm so glad I decided to come back for a check-up with her. She examined my teeth thoroughly, cleaned out all the tartar, and after the procedure, she checked everything, filled cavities, and gave me lots of information and advice. Thank you so much, Dr. Waleeporn! The price was reasonable, and there's parking available.

The doctor explained everything very well. It's a true success for both doctor and patient. I'm very impressed. The price was affordable, and the doctor explained every step of the process. They were gentle and very experienced. I wish them many patients!
Dr. Waleeporn is lovely, kind, and provides very detailed advice and recommendations. The clinic is clean and the service is fast.

Today I had my teeth cleaned (tartar removed). Dr. Waleeporn was very attentive and spent almost an hour removing the tartar (unlike some well-known brands that finish in 10 minutes and seem to do a rushed job). My teeth are now clean, I feel confident, and I don't have bad breath. I highly recommend this place! 😁 …

I recommend this place.
It was great. I had root canal treatment there before. It wasn't stressful at all; the doctor was fun.
It's located at the entrance of the soi (alley), next to Kasikorn Bank, Pinklao branch.
